description: 在世界树根部啃噬、持续侵蚀宇宙秩序的存在。
fullDescription: 《格里姆尼尔之歌》第35节将Níðhöggr与世界树根部的啃噬联系起来。来源并未要求采用现代西方有翼喷火巨龙模板，因此本卡应优先表现长形、蛇龙/古龙式的根部侵蚀者，身体大部分隐入根系与暗处，核心是‘咬住世界树根’这一动作。
roleInSeries: 以根部侵蚀结束M01对稳定世界秩序的幻想。
visualThesis: 根系深处的长形蛇龙/古龙式生物，头部和咬住根系的动作清晰，身体隐入阴影和根网；不做喷火飞龙Boss。

sourceBoundFacts: 与世界树根部啃噬相关
interpretationNotes: 具体翅膀、角、甲片等现代龙类特征不应视为来源事实
可采用wyrm/serpentine draconic轮廓以避免现代西方龙定型
canon.worldState: 世界树秩序已经建立，但根部从一开始就受到侵蚀。
mustKeep: 头部和咬合动作安全可见

instructions: 与Sköll/Hati：不是狼类追逐构图，而是根部伏击/啃噬
不复用天穹背景，空间必须是世界树根部深层

visual.detailHierarchy: 眼、口、牙和咬合根系最高细节；身体和背景逐渐隐入暗处。
visual.subjectSeparation: 用头部局部亮度与根系交界突出动作，远处全降细节。

prompt.draft: Create Níðhöggr at the roots of Yggdrasil as an ancient serpentine draconic/wyrm-like being actively gnawing a massive world-tree root. The head, jaws and bite point must be the clear focal action; most of the long body should recede into shadow, roots and damp darkness. Do not use a modern Western winged fire-breathing dragon template, armor plating, game-boss pose or spectacle flames. The mythology comes from the root-gnawing relationship, not extra fantasy decoration. Keep head and bite safely within the upper-middle crop-safe region. Root-depth environment, restrained painterly detail, background darker and softer than the subject.

Content brief: Create Níðhöggr at the roots of Yggdrasil as an ancient serpentine draconic/wyrm-like being actively gnawing a massive world-tree root. The head, jaws and bite point must be the clear focal action; most of the long body should recede into shadow, roots and damp darkness. Do not use a modern Western winged fire-breathing dragon template, armor plating, game-boss pose or spectacle flames. The mythology comes from the root-gnawing relationship, not extra fantasy decoration. Keep head and bite safely within the upper-middle crop-safe region. Visual thesis: 根系深处的长形蛇龙/古龙式生物，头部和咬住根系的动作清晰，身体隐入阴影和根网；不做喷火飞龙Boss。

Identity anchors: 蛇龙/古龙式轮廓；咬住Yggdrasil根；身体隐入根系；地下/根部空间

Must keep: 头部和咬合动作安全可见；根系是第二视觉主体；不喷火

Must avoid: 有翼喷火巨龙；装甲Boss；宝石龙；站立西方龙；大面积火焰；普通恐龙

Composition: camera low eye level; shot close three-quarter bite action; keep the primary subject/action inside the crop-safe upper-middle area.

Match the established M01 artwork family: painterly mythic realism with matte surfaces, broad readable shapes, controlled cinematic blue-white frost and restrained ember light, atmospheric depth, limited focal sharpness, and restrained brush detail. Subject or key moment must be sharper and more contrasted than the background. Use mythology-first visual storytelling rather than generic AI fantasy. Keep at most one primary environmental motif and one secondary motif; preserve quiet areas and clear visual hierarchy. Compose for future card crop safety: the face, hands, identity symbol, key object, or story action must work in the upper-middle area; the bottom 30 percent may be sacrificed.

Color and material guidance: palette 深木褐；苔黑绿；骨灰；冷湿蓝; materials 树根；湿土；鳞/皮；暗水; mood ominous；root-bound；ancient；restrained.

Related card IDs for narrative continuity only: 1003010014；1003010015. Preserve their mythic relationship without cloning faces, silhouettes, or poses.

Avoid these failure modes: winged dragon；fire breathing；armored dragon；game boss；gem-covered dragon；dinosaur；open sky；wolf-like pose；typography；glossy game-CG; excessive particles, floating debris overload, glossy game-CG, hyper-detailed-everything, random glowing runes, generic Viking cosplay, modern copyrighted adaptation, malformed anatomy, extra limbs, unreadable hands or props.

Fill one complete portrait 9:16 canvas with no margins. Target final canvas at least 1620x2880 pixels.
